title: leucanthemum segetum
intro: Leucanthemum segetum, commonly known as corn marigold, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the sunflower family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum segetum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antiseptic activities. The bioactive constituents of Leucanthemum segetum may also contribute to its potential in reducing inflammation and fighting off infections, making it a promising candidate for further research in traditional medicine.
